name: CDW (US enterprise IT reseller) — NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell workstation card line
price_basis: PNY NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 96GB GDDR7 (MFG VCNRTXPRO6000B-PB, CDW 8326705) advertised price, pre-tax, observed 2026-10-03, state 'Item Backordered'. Same line, same day: PNY full-height variant $16,233.99.
notes: Scoped to the workstation card line only; the repo's separate cdw-enterprise record covers CDW's server and cloud configurations and carries no published price. The workstation card line is not cheap or fast: of six results on 2026-10-03, three were 'Item Backordered', one was '4-6+ Weeks', and two were 'Request Pricing' with no published figure at all. Two actionable observations. First, the PNY full-height bracket variant is $16,233.99 against $19,977.99 for standard height - a $3,744 spread for a bracket, worth shopping deliberately. Second, this channel is materially more expensive than US consumer/pro channels for the same silicon: B&H listed PNY RTX PRO 6000 Workstation at $16,499.00 and Micro Center stocked NVIDIA Workstation Edition in store at $15,899.99-$15,999.99 on the same date, so CDW is roughly 21-26% above those. If you have the paperwork to buy through a consumer or big-box channel, do. Lead time of 6 weeks is inference - the midpoint of the only lead time CDW published ('4-6+ Weeks') - and is not a quote.
